Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer identifies the largest demographic as "Black/African American, 80%." This implies the demographic group with the highest representation among students is Black/African American, making up 80% of attendees. The Predicted Answer instead identifies the largest group as "full-time students—about 73% of enrollment," which refers to enrollment status (full-time vs. part-time), not demographic category (such as race or ethnicity). No mention is made in the Predicted Answer of racial or ethnic demographics or of the proportion of Black/African American students. Therefore, the substance and vital facts of the Ground Truth Answer are not present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: FALSE
